name: bulk-result-summary
title: Bulk result summary
description: The outcome of a batch job in numbers: what worked, what was skipped and what failed, with each failure's reason and a retry.
docs: total, succeeded, skipped and failures ({ id, label, reason }[]) give the counts; a fourth, not processed, appears when they do not add up to total. verb ("Imported") and noun ("contacts", or { one, other }) write the headline. With no failures the panel is one calm line. More than foldAfter (5) failures fold behind Show all n. onRetryFailed and onDownloadReport may return promises and show a spinner meanwhile; when Retry settles the panel takes the focus, so a screen reader reads the new counts (settle it once they are in), and Download report takes its own focus back. The bar never relies on colour: each part has a pattern (solid, dots, hatch) and a written count, and a screen reader hears the counts as the panel's description. The panel takes focus once on mount unless autoFocus is false.
